_instructions: Copy these template configurations into your EmailJS admin dashboard (https://dashboard.emailjs.com/admin)

businessman_email_template._description: Template sent to the businessman when a customer submits the contact form
businessman_email_template.template_id: TEMPLATE_ID_HERE — create this in EmailJS dashboard
businessman_email_template.subject: 🚀 New Service Request: {{service}}
businessman_email_template.body_html:
New Contact Form Submission

👤 Name{{name}}
📧 Email{{email}}
📞 Phone{{phone}}
🛠 Service{{service}}
📌 Subject{{subject}}
📝 Message{{message}}

Submitted on: {{date}}

customer_email_template._description: Auto-reply / confirmation email sent to the customer
customer_email_template.template_id: TEMPLATE_ID_HERE — create this in EmailJS dashboard

setup_steps: 2. Go to 'Email Templates' and click 'Create New Template' (create two templates)
3. For the businessman template: copy the subject and body from 'businessman_email_template' above
4. For the customer template: copy the subject and body from 'customer_email_template' above
5. After creating each template, note the Template ID (e.g., template_xyz123)
6. Replace TEMPLATE_ID_HERE in this file with your actual template IDs
7. Add the template IDs and your Public Key to the .env file (see .env.example)
